inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Data Connector Health Check - Azure Storage

properties.description: This rule will identify if any Azure Storage Account logs stopped reporting to Sentinel in last 3 days
properties.displayName: [NopalCyber] Data Connector Health Check - Azure Storage
properties.query:
union isfuzzy=true
    (StorageBlobLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | summarize LastCall1 = max(TimeGenerated) by AccountName, Type),
    (StorageFileLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | summarize LastCall1 = max(TimeGenerated) by AccountName, Type),
    (StorageTableLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | summarize LastCall1 = max(TimeGenerated) by AccountName, Type),
    (StorageQueueLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | summarize LastCall1 = max(TimeGenerated) by AccountName, Type)
| extend Dataconnector = "Azure Storage"
| summarize LastCall = max(LastCall1) by Dataconnector, AccountName
| extend LogIngestionStatus = iff(LastCall < ago(3d), 'No', 'Yes')
| where LogIngestionStatus == "No"
